newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy in contacts with Israeli, PLO leaders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy in contacts with Israeli, PLO leaders.

text.p: U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross spoke by telephone with the Israeli and Palestinian leaders on Saturday in a bid to finalise terms for an Israeli withdrawal from Hebron in the West Bank, a PLO official said.
The official, who refused to be named, said agreement on the long overdue redeployment could be reached within 48 hours.
Members of the Israeli and Palestinian negotiating teams met late on Saturday in Jerusalem ahead of a formal resumption of the talks in Eilat on Monday.

Israel agreed in a deal with the PLO last year to withdraw troops from major West Bank towns but delayed its pullout from Hebron, the last town slated for withdrawal, after a wave of militant Islamic suicide bombings in February and March.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who succeeded the Labour governement that negotiated the deal with the Palestinians in elections last May, put the agreement on hold, saying changes were needed to enhance security for Jewish settlers.
Four hundred Jewish settlers live among 100,000 Palestinians in Hebron, a town holy to Moslems and Jews.
